H01-pos1.label: violation
H01-pos1.note: Domain policy imports the Clock port from the application layer to decide loan expiry.

H01-pos2.label: violation
H01-pos2.note: Domain entity ConditionReport is decorated with typeorm persistence decorators, a framework dependency in the domain.

H01-twin1.label: clean
H01-twin1.note: Same expiry feature, but the domain policy takes the current time as a plain Date argument and imports only domain files.

H01-twin2.label: clean
H01-twin2.note: Persistence mapping with typeorm decorators lives in an outbound adapter record that maps to and from the domain entity.

H01-legit.label: clean
H01-legit.note: A new domain value-carrying entity named FrameworkAgreement (a lending agreement between museums) imports only sibling domain files; the word framework is business vocabulary.

H02-pos1.label: violation
H02-pos1.note: Request use case imports the SystemClock adapter and types its constructor parameter by it instead of the Clock port.

H02-pos2.label: violation
H02-pos2.note: Approve use case value-imports the formatMoney helper from the inbound HTTP DTO module.

H02-twin1.label: clean
H02-twin1.note: Same timestamped notification, but the use case keeps the Clock port type and imports only ports and domain.

H02-twin2.label: clean
H02-twin2.note: Same premium in the notification, formatted with the domain Money.toString instead of an adapter helper.

H02-legit.label: clean
H02-legit.note: Eligibility check is extracted into an application service used by the use case; it imports only domain and sibling application code.

H03-pos1.label: violation
H03-pos1.note: Inbound controller imports the SystemClock outbound adapter and instantiates it to stamp the response.

H03-pos2.label: violation
H03-pos2.note: Courier outbound adapter takes the LogNotifier outbound adapter (type-only import) as a constructor parameter.

H03-twin1.label: clean
H03-twin1.note: Same response timestamp, but the controller receives the Clock port by constructor and main wires it.

H03-twin2.label: clean
H03-twin2.note: Same courier-booked log, but the courier adapter depends on the Notifier port and main wires the adapter.

H03-legit.label: clean
H03-legit.note: The repository imports a sibling record module from its own persistence package, not another adapter package.

H04-pos1.label: violation
H04-pos1.note: LoanRepository.save takes an optional pg PoolClient, a database handle, as a parameter.

H04-pos2.label: violation
H04-pos2.note: New QuoteArchive out-port returns an axios AxiosResponse, a vendor type, from its method.

H04-twin1.label: clean
H04-twin1.note: Same optional transaction scope, expressed as an application-defined UnitOfWork interface declared in the port file.

H04-twin2.label: clean
H04-twin2.note: Same QuoteArchive port, returning the domain InsuranceQuote rather than a vendor response.

H04-legit.label: clean
H04-legit.note: A Postgres repository adapter uses the pg PoolClient internally via its constructor while implementing the clean LoanRepository port.

H05-pos1.label: violation
H05-pos1.note: Request use case defaults its clock parameter to a newly constructed SystemClock adapter.

H05-pos2.label: violation
H05-pos2.note: Approve use case builds a LogNotifier adapter inside its method for an audit message.

H05-twin1.label: clean
H05-twin1.note: Default clock is an inline object literal implementing the Clock port, not a concrete adapter class.

H05-twin2.label: clean
H05-twin2.note: Approve use case constructs domain objects (Money, InsuranceQuote) with new for in-house loans, never an adapter.

H05-legit.label: clean
H05-legit.note: Use case builds a domain service (new LoanPolicy) and plain collections with new; these are not adapters.

H06-pos1.label: violation
H06-pos1.note: Controller computes loan duration and rejects requests over 180 days, a business rule decided in the inbound adapter.

H06-pos2.label: violation
H06-pos2.note: Repository save decides to reject loans of blocked borrowers, mutating domain state inside persistence.

H06-twin1.label: clean
H06-twin1.note: Controller only translates the domain LoanTooLongError into HTTP 422; the duration rule stays in LoanPolicy.

H06-twin2.label: clean
H06-twin2.note: Blocked-borrower rejection is a LoanPolicy method applied by the request use case.

H06-legit.label: clean
H06-legit.note: Insurance gateway retries a transient 503 from the insurer, a technical resilience concern with no domain decision.

H07-pos1.label: violation
H07-pos1.note: Domain error carries an HTTP status code (402) as a field.

H07-pos2.label: violation
H07-pos2.note: Application use case takes an Express Request object as its method parameter.

H07-twin1.label: clean
H07-twin1.note: Domain error carries a transport-free code and the controller maps it to HTTP 402.

H07-twin2.label: clean
H07-twin2.note: Same webhook use case, taking a plain ApprovalWebhookCommand instead of a transport request.

H07-legit.label: clean
H07-legit.note: A driving port defines a business LoanResponse (the museum's answer to a borrower) with status and decision fields; no transport concepts.

H08-pos1.label: violation
H08-pos1.note: Approve use case pulls a Notifier from a static ServiceRegistry.resolve call at run time.

H08-pos2.label: violation
H08-pos2.note: Controller field initializer obtains the Clock through the module-level resolve function of a registry.

H08-twin1.label: clean
H08-twin1.note: The registrar audit notification arrives as a second Notifier constructor parameter that main wires.

H08-twin2.label: clean
H08-twin2.note: The use case receives a NotifierFactory port by constructor and main wires a lookup function into it.

H08-legit.label: clean
H08-legit.note: Only the composition root uses a local registry map to assemble values; main is allowed to assemble dependencies.

H09-pos1.label: violation
H09-pos1.note: Request use case runs a label-printer child process with execFileSync imported from node:child_process.

H09-pos2.label: violation
H09-pos2.note: Domain policy performs a network call with the global fetch to load a blocked-borrower list.

H09-twin1.label: clean
H09-twin1.note: Label printing goes through a LabelPrinter out-port, with the child process confined to an outbound adapter.

H09-twin2.label: clean
H09-twin2.note: Domain policy checks blocked borrowers against a list passed in as data; no I/O in the domain.

H09-legit.label: clean
H09-legit.note: An outbound adapter reads condition reports from a JSON file with node:fs; adapters are where I/O belongs.

H10-pos1.label: violation
H10-pos1.note: Controller get returns the LoanRequest domain entity directly as the response body.

H10-pos2.label: violation
H10-pos2.note: New controller accepts the ConditionReport domain entity as its request body type.

H10-twin1.label: clean
H10-twin1.note: Same loan detail with the period length, added to the LoanDto and mapped in toLoanDto; the controller still returns a DTO.

H10-twin2.label: clean
H10-twin2.note: Same controller, but the request type is a ConditionReportBody DTO mapped to the domain entity inside the adapter.

H10-legit.label: clean
H10-legit.note: The DTO types its status field with the LoanStatus string-literal union from the domain; the body is still a DTO, not an entity.
